name: Plunger lift and hydraulic jet pumps
aliases: Plunger lift and hydraulic jet pumps
principle: Plunger lift uses the well's own gas pressure to push a plunger and liquid slug up the tubing; hydraulic pumps (piston, jet) are driven by power fluid from the surface. Jet pumps tolerate solids above 50% by volume and hydraulic pumps cover about 1,000 to 18,000 ft.

process_steps.name: Gas pressure builds under the plunger
Well flows; plunger falls and cycle repeats

key_equipment: hydraulic jet pump and power-fluid system
